purpose: Fix calibration layout/averaging, response bounds, profile validation, gamepad curves/buttons/axes and optional RGB guards.
Expose optional frame, travel conversion, calibration thresholds and Fn-state hooks without BAT68 board knowledge in HE core.
Keep measured steady-state auto-calibration and integer delta optimizations separate from correctness fixes.
Save batched RGB fields and preserve inclusive brightness endpoints.
Use the pinned quantum EEPROM keymap pointer API.
Reuse Launcher command dispatch on any QMK host transport, bound version formatting and expose optional HE/VIA policy hooks; disable unavailable services explicitly.
Allow an explicit storage compatibility date instead of coupling persistent VIA keymaps/macros to the current firmware build date.
